Cross-Network Module Comparison Heatmap

Source: R/type_module_compare.R
type_module_compare.Rd

Creates publication-ready cross-network module comparison plots to evaluate module preservation, overlap, and reorganization across distinct biological conditions, cohorts, timepoints, or tissues (e.g., Discovery vs Replication, Health vs Disease, Infant vs Mother, or Microbiome vs Host). Evaluates module correspondence using hypergeometric test statistics, Jaccard similarity indices, representation factors (fold enrichment), and raw overlap counts.

Usage

type_module_compare(
  fill_by = c("log10p", "jaccard", "overlap", "rf"),
  show_counts = TRUE,
  show_p = FALSE,
  show_stars = TRUE,
  text_size = 3.2,
  text_color = "auto",
  colors = c("#F7FBFF", "#9ECAE1", "#2171B5", "#08306B"),
  na_color = "white",
  border_color = "#DCE2EC",
  border_size = 0.3,
  legend_title = NULL,
  show_totals = TRUE,
  total_universe = NULL,
  min_overlap = 0,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_by

Metric used for tile fill color: "log10p" (-\(\log_{10}(p)\) from hypergeometric test, default), "jaccard" (Jaccard similarity index), "overlap" (count of shared nodes), or "rf" (representation factor / fold enrichment).

show_counts

Logical. If TRUE, displays the number of shared features in each cell. Default TRUE.

show_p

Logical. If TRUE, displays the hypergeometric p-value (or -log10 p) in each cell. Default FALSE.

show_stars

Logical. If TRUE, appends significance asterisks (* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001). Default TRUE.

text_size

Numeric text size for cell annotations (default 3.2).

text_color

Character color for cell annotations. If "auto" (default), chooses white for dark tiles and dark grey for light tiles.

colors

Sequential or gradient color vector for fill scale. Default c("#F7FBFF", "#9ECAE1", "#2171B5", "#08306B").

na_color

Background color for cells with zero overlap (default "white").

border_color

Outline color for tiles (default "#DCE2EC").

border_size

Outline stroke width (default 0.3).

legend_title

Legend title string (default depends on fill_by).

show_totals

Logical. If TRUE, appends module member counts to axis labels (e.g. "M1 (n=45)"). Default TRUE.

total_universe

Optional integer specifying the total shared feature universe size N for the hypergeometric test. If NULL, calculated automatically from unique features in the input data.

min_overlap

Minimum overlap count required to display text label (default 0).

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Simulated node-level network module assignments
set.seed(42)
genes <- paste0("Gene_", 1:120)
net1 <- sample(c("M1_Inflam", "M2_Barrier", "M3_Lipid"), 120, replace = TRUE)
net2 <- net1
idx <- sample(1:120, 35)
net2[idx] <- sample(c("ModA_Th2", "ModB_Stratum", "ModC_Sebum"), 35, replace = TRUE)

df_nodes <- data.frame(Discovery = net1, Replication = net2)
cliplot(Replication ~ Discovery, data = df_nodes, type = type_module_compare())
} # }
